approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: A subject such as RFI Status Update currently suppresses a valid Submittal body heading even though the subject has no digit-bearing identifier.
The reverse case, Submittal Coordination with an exact RFI body heading, is suppressed in the same way.
Reuse the existing conservative identifier normalizer before granting Subject precedence; keep the Subject visible as email-header evidence.
No fuzzy subject matching, semantic classification, mailbox access or model call is permitted.
631 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline; both invalid-Subject directions retain header evidence and route the exact body primary with zero model calls.
title: Require a valid workflow Subject identifier
objective: Grant Email Subject routing precedence only when the exact RFI or Submittal Subject contains an identifier accepted by the existing digit-bearing normalizer.
